<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Claw and Talon Flow](/Feats.aspx?ID=5448) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 69

**Archetype** [Clawdancer](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=221)

**Prerequisites**
[Clawdancer Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5436)

**Requirements**
You’re in either claw stance or talon stance.

</column>

---

You fluidly shift between your two stances. You use the unarmed attack associated with your current clawdancer stance, then switch into the other stance (if you're in claw stance, make a frenzied claw Strike and then shift to talon stance, or vice versa).
name: Claw and Talon Flow
requirement: You’re in either claw stance or talon stance.
